# 停用词集，定义了常见的用于过滤的词语
STOP_ENTITIES = {'概述', '摘要', '设计', '应用', '定义', '意义', '意思', '解说', '定理', '技巧',
                 '步骤', '概念', '总结', '拓展', '解释', '推理', '介绍', '结构', '结论', '什么',
                 '奥秘', '说明', '指南', '原理', '流程', '经验', '道理', '类目', '简介', '观点',
                 '引例', '示意', '公理', '实例', '方案', '概況', '方法', '类型', '示例', '详解',
                 '研究', '案例', '推论', '奥妙', '实验', '引言', '模式', '重点', '浅析', '影响',
                 '价值', '评价', '目的', '汇总', '术语', '问题', '是', '方法', '概况', '归纳',
                 '叙述', '诠释', '概要', '概貌', '阐释', '条例', '基本', '性质', '其他', '其它',
                 '基本概念', '基本原则'}

# 允许的词性标记
ALLOW_POS = ['eng', 'a', 'an', 'as', 's', 'n', 'ng', 'nr', 'nrfg', 'nrt', 'ns', 'nt', 'nz',
             'v', 'vd', 'vi', 'vn', 'vq', 'l', 'i', 'd', 'df', 'h', 'k', "t", "f", "zg", 'g',
             'm', 'b']

# 连接词，如“的”，“与”，“和”等
and_words = "的|与|和|是|及"

def extract_and_merge_continuous_nouns(word_pos_list: List[Tuple[str, str]], word_weight: Dict[str, int]) -> Dict[str, int]:
    """
    从词性标注列表中提取连续名词片段，并更新其在权重字典中的权重。

    参数:
        word_pos_list (List[Tuple[str, str]]): 包含词和词性的元组列表。
        word_weight (Dict[str, int]): 存储词和对应权重的字典。

    返回:
        Dict[str, int]: 更新后的权重字典。
    """
    if not word_pos_list or not isinstance(word_weight, dict):
        return word_weight

    pre_tag = ''
    current_noun_sequence = []  # 当前连续名词片段
    for index, (word, tag) in enumerate(word_pos_list):
        next_tag = word_pos_list[index + 1].flag if index + 1 < len(word_pos_list) else ''

        if ('n' in tag) \
            or (tag in ['a', 'an', 'v', 'l', 'm'] and 'n' in next_tag) \
            or (tag in ['v'] and 'n' in pre_tag):
            current_noun_sequence.append(word)
        elif current_noun_sequence:
            # 处理并清空当前名词片段
            if len(current_noun_sequence) > 1:
                max_weight = max(word_weight.get(word, 1) for word in current_noun_sequence)
                merged_noun = ''.join(current_noun_sequence)
                word_weight[merged_noun] = max_weight
            current_noun_sequence = []

        pre_tag = tag

    if current_noun_sequence and len(current_noun_sequence) > 1:
        max_weight = max(word_weight.get(word, 1) for word in current_noun_sequence)
        merged_noun = ''.join(current_noun_sequence)
        word_weight[merged_noun] = max_weight

    return word_weight

def build_weighted_keywords_zh(text: str, mode: str = "all") -> List[Dict[str, float]]:
    """
    构建加权关键词列表。

    参数:
        text: 输入文本。
        mode: 模式，可以为 "all" 或 "filter"。

    返回:
        包含 'word' 和 'boost' 的字典列表。
    """
    text = str(text).strip()
    if len(text) <= 5:
        words = analyse.extract_tags(text, topK=10, withWeight=True)
    else:
        words = analyse.extract_tags(text, topK=10, withWeight=True, allowPOS=ALLOW_POS)

    words_dict = {word: weight for word, weight in words if word not in STOP_ENTITIES}
    
    if not words_dict:
        return [{'word': text, 'boost': 2}]
    
    words_pos = psg.lcut(text)
    
    for word_obj in words_pos:
        if re.findall(r'[nv]', word_obj.flag) and word_obj.word in words_dict:
            words_dict[word_obj.word] *= 1.2

    words_dict = dict(sorted(words_dict.items(), key=lambda item: item[1], reverse=True))
    weight, word_weight1 = 0., {}
    words = [(key, value) for key, value in words_dict.items()]
    total_score = sum([line[1] for line in words])
    
    for line in words[::-1]:
        weight += line[1]
        if weight / total_score < 0.4:
            word_weight1[line[0]] = 1
        elif 0.4 <= weight / total_score < 0.7:
            word_weight1[line[0]] = 1.5
        elif weight / total_score >= 0.7:
            word_weight1[line[0]] = 2

    for i, line in enumerate(words_pos[:-2]):
        if re.findall(r'[ng]', line.flag) and len(line.word) == 1 and line.word not in word_weight1.keys():
            if re.findall(and_words, words_pos[i + 1].word):
                word = line.word + words_pos[i + 1].word + words_pos[i + 2].word
                word_weight1[word] = 2
            elif not any(line.word in word for word in word_weight1.keys()):
                word = line.word + words_pos[i + 1].word
                word_weight1[word] = 2

    for i, line in enumerate(words_pos[-2:]):
        if re.findall(r'[ng]', line.flag) and len(line.word) == 1 and line.word not in word_weight1.keys():
            word_weight1[line.word] = 1

    word_weight1 = extract_and_merge_continuous_nouns(words_pos, word_weight1)

    if mode == "filter":
        keys = sorted(word_weight1.keys(), key=lambda x: len(x), reverse=True)
        final_keys = []
        new_word_weight1 = {}
        for line in keys:
            if line not in final_keys and not any(line in word for word in final_keys):
                final_keys.append(line)
                new_word_weight1[line] = word_weight1[line]
    else:
        new_word_weight1 = dict(sorted(word_weight1.items(), key=lambda item: len(item[0]), reverse=True))

    word_weight1 = sorted(new_word_weight1.items(), key=lambda item: item[1], reverse=True)

    return [{'word': line[0], 'boost': line[1]} for line in word_weight1[:10]]

    words_dict = {word: weight for word, weight in words if word not in STOP_ENTITIES}
    
    if not words_dict:
        return [{'word': text, 'boost': 2}]
    
    words_pos = psg.lcut(text)
    
    for word_obj in words_pos:
        if re.findall(r'[nv]', word_obj.flag) and word_obj.word in words_dict:
            words_dict[word_obj.word] *= 1.2

    words_dict = dict(sorted(words_dict.items(), key=lambda item: item[1], reverse=True))
    weight, word_weight1 = 0., {}
    words = [(key, value) for key, value in words_dict.items()]
    total_score = sum([line[1] for line in words])
    
    for line in words[::-1]:
        weight += line[1]
        if weight / total_score < 0.4:
            word_weight1[line[0]] = 1
        elif 0.4 <= weight / total_score < 0.7:
            word_weight1[line[0]] = 1.5
        elif weight / total_score >= 0.7:
            word_weight1[line[0]] = 2

    for i, line in enumerate(words_pos[:-2]):
        if re.findall(r'[ng]', line.flag) and len(line.word) == 1 and line.word not in word_weight1.keys():
            if re.findall(and_words, words_pos[i + 1].word):
                word = line.word + words_pos[i + 1].word + words_pos[i + 2].word
                word_weight1[word] = 2
            elif not any(line.word in word for word in word_weight1.keys()):
                word = line.word + words_pos[i + 1].word
                word_weight1[word] = 2

    for i, line in enumerate(words_pos[-2:]):
        if re.findall(r'[ng]', line.flag) and len(line.word) == 1 and line.word not in word_weight1.keys():
            word_weight1[line.word] = 1

    word_weight1 = extract_and_merge_continuous_nouns(words_pos, word_weight1)

    if mode == "filter":
        keys = sorted(word_weight1.keys(), key=lambda x: len(x), reverse=True)
        final_keys = []
        new_word_weight1 = {}
        for line in keys:
            if line not in final_keys and not any(line in word for word in final_keys):
                final_keys.append(line)
                new_word_weight1[line] = word_weight1[line]
    else:
        new_word_weight1 = dict(sorted(word_weight1.items(), key=lambda item: len(item[0]), reverse=True))

    word_weight1 = sorted(new_word_weight1.items(), key=lambda item: item[1], reverse=True)

    return [{'word': line[0], 'boost': line[1]} for line in word_weight1[:10]]
